_comment: REAL ui_snapshot output under WDA (the normalized UiNode tree, adapters/wda-source.ts#parseWdaSource), iPhone 17 simulator,
iOS 27.0, 402x874 pt, averi arch/round-12 @ 20307d2, 2026-10-13 — the round-12 device check (run12-ios). Whole screens, unedited;
each key names its screen and its session call:
finportalForgot (#248, FP-forgot-wda.json): Finportal (React Native) login screen with ForgotPasswordModal up — an RN transparent Modal
laid in the same window after the screen: a leaf `forgot_overlay 0,0 402x874` (the dimming root), empty frames, the card `forgot_modal`
and `forgot_close`. docs/bugs/2026-10-13-ios-wda-rn-transparent-modal-dim-overlay-is-no-cover-tap-reported-done.md
finportalLogin (#218, FP-login-wda.json): the same login screen, no modal.
contactsSheet (#146, M1-wda-contacts-sheet.json): Contacts list with the New Contact page sheet over it, in the same window: the
dimming leaf `-402,-874 1206x2622`, the sheet `0,62 402x812` and its form `scrollable 0,62 402x812`.
contactsSheetScrolled (#150, M1-wda-contacts-sheet2.json): the same, the sheet scrolled 10 pt, keyboard down.
docs/bugs/2026-10-13-ios-wda-sheet-background-is-no-cover-tap-goes-through-to-the-screen-beneath.md
safariPageB (#158, W-wda-b.json): Safari on a local test page (127.0.0.1) after `tap role:text text:"Go to page B"` was
measured Tapped (#157, round-12 row "W web view — holds"): the web view in the app's Window, then `CapsuleViewController 0,0
402x874`, a full-screen pass-through layer carrying the bottom bar (Back, Tabs) — a later stacked layer that draws only its bar.
Added from the next device check (run13-ios: averi arch/round-13 @ d407256, 2026-10-14), same simulator, unedited:
swiftFeesSheet (#153, A6-wda-fees-sheet.json): mp-native's SWIFT form with the Fees sheet at its half detent (`Sheet Grabber`
v='Half screen'), in a later layer of the app's Window: the dim is a LABELLED leaf, `container 'dismiss popup'
id=PopoverDismissRegion -402,-874 1206x2622`, then the sheet `8,415 386x451` (its form `scrollable`, rows OUR/SHA/BEN).
swiftFeesSheetExpanded (#158, A6-wda-fees-sheet-after-swipe.json): the same after scroll_until's one stroke moved the sheet to
`Expanded`: the dim an unlabelled leaf now, the sheet `0,62 402x812`.
docs/bugs/2026-10-14-ios-wda-sheet-dim-labelled-dismiss-region-is-no-presented-screen-scroll-until-swipes-the-sheet.md
contactsDiscardPopover (#93, X-wda-discard-popover.json): Contacts' New Contact sheet with its "Discard Changes" popover up, keyboard
shown: a third layer of the app's Window carrying `container 'dismiss popup' id=PopoverDismissRegion 0,0 402x874`, a labelled leaf,
and beside it the popover `other 10,78 240x169`; scroll_until on the sheet's `Insert add instant message` swiped and closed it.
The device check of round 14's tree of the same popover with the keyboard DOWN (run14-ios/D-contacts-discard-popover.json) is not
copied here: the tests read it from its raw capture, tests/fixtures/wda-capture-contacts-discard-popover.json, through the current
adapters/wda-source.ts#parseWdaSource — one source of truth, the parse never stale.

Each screen's root carries `unclippedFrames: true`, added after capture: the WDA parser marks every tree so now (adapters/types.ts#UiNode.unclippedFrames), and ui_snapshot prints it; nothing else edited.
